calculation.deductionAndExemptionRule: Subtract the filing-status deduction plus $1,000 for each exemption before Method II or III. Published direct amounts exist for daily, weekly, biweekly, semimonthly, monthly, and annual periods.

federalAllowanceCompatibility.dynamicRule: Recalculate as current federal allowance minus $1,000 rather than freezing $3,300.

topIncomeWholeWageRates.warning: Method III applies its rate to all annualized net wages; it is not an ordinary marginal continuation of Method II.

supplementalWages.notSeparatelyIdentified: Apply the ordinary method to the combined payment.
separatelyPaidOrIdentifiedMethods: Aggregate with the most recent regular payroll this year and subtract regular withholding

rounding.operationalPolicy: Use the printed Method II table rate and base amount and round the variable-rate product to cents with midpoint rounding away from zero before adding the printed base amount.
rounding.publicationConflictDisposition: Treat the two inconsistent semimonthly examples as agency publication errors; they do not override the printed table parameters.

residencyAndWorkRules.residentRule: All wages paid to a New York resident are subject to New York withholding regardless of work location or assignment duration.
residencyAndWorkRules.residentOtherJurisdictionCredit: Reduce otherwise-required New York withholding by income tax required to be withheld by other states, their political subdivisions, or DC; do not reduce below zero.
residencyAndWorkRules.nonresidentPhysicalWork: Withhold on New York work wages; allocate by New York workdays over total workdays, or by New York sales volume for compensation entirely dependent on business volume.
residencyAndWorkRules.missingNonresidentAllocationCertificate: Withhold on all wages unless Form IT-2104.1 is filed or adequate current source-wage records are maintained.

convenienceRule.appliesWhen: A nonresident or part-year resident has an assigned or primary New York work location and works from an out-of-state home office

residencyAndWorkRules.interstateRailAndMotorCarrierRule: Regular multistate carrier duties are taxed only by residence.
residencyAndWorkRules.airCarrierRule: A nonresident is subject only if more than 50% of scheduled flight time is in New York; then withholding applies to compensation.
residencyAndWorkRules.sailorRule: Do not withhold for covered foreign, coastwise, intercoastal, interstate, noncontiguous, fishing-vessel, or fish-processing-vessel trade unless voluntarily requested.

captureWarnings: The published semimonthly married example reports $248.11, while its printed line-7 rate and base amount calculate to $248.12 under the approved ordinary-cent policy. This is recorded as an agency publication error and is not an activation blocker.

The published semimonthly single example reports $258.51, while its printed line-7 rate and base amount calculate to $258.50 under the approved ordinary-cent policy. This is recorded as an agency publication error and is not an activation blocker.
Method III uses whole-wage average rates rather than marginal brackets; representing it as a normal bracket would materially over- or under-withhold.
The federal-allowance compatibility adjustment is explicitly inflation-sensitive and must not be frozen at the publication's 2025 federal amount.
The full 14-day policy conditions and complete direct wage-bracket, dollar-to-dollar, and exact period matrices remain untranscribed.
